entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
Hi, my name is Alex Chen. The order number is VF8675309. I'm calling because... well, I'm just so disappointed.

I'm sorry to hear that, Alex. Let me pull up your order. I see you purchased the ProFit Jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference, I guess. It's just the wrong size. I waited so long to buy this specific jersey, and it's just too tight. I really feel let down.
I can certainly understand that frustration. Getting the perfect fit is so important. Have you considered an exchange for a different size?

I looked online, but the next size up is sold out in this color. I was hoping to exchange it, but now I just... I really need the money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and with the holidays right here, I was counting on this working out.
Of course, Alex, I completely understand. Loyalty means a lot to us at VeloFit. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the delivery was about 58 days ago.
Okay, I've checked our policy. You're well within the 90-day return window for standard items like this jersey. I can absolutely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, Sarah. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. This is such a relief. This is why I stick with VeloFit.

It's my pleasure, Alex. And since you're one of our VIP customers, I've gone ahead and generated a pre-paid return shipping label for you, so you won't have to pay to send it back. I'm emailing that to you now. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it at any post office.
That's fantastic. Thank you again, Sarah. You've really helped me out today.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Happy holidays to you too, Alex. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
